description: This file defines a route component for the recipes index page in a Remix-run web application. It includes metadata configuration, a data loader for fetching recipes based on search filters, and a React component that renders the search filters, recipe list, and pagination controls.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines page metadata, such as title and description.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Async function to fetch recipes based on URL search parameters, handling errors and returning JSON data.

methods.name: RecipesPage
methods.description: Main React component for rendering the recipes list page with filters, search, and pagination.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: Component for rendering pagination controls with next/previous buttons and page number buttons.
